_comment: 'Your first sword attack this turn gets go again' is modelled as a one-shot GRANT_NEXT_ATTACK_KEYWORD (handler effect_types.py:4735 reads keyword/filter/scope; consumed by engine._apply_turn_attack_effects on the first attack matching filter, cleared end of turn). Exact when Blade Rush is played before any sword attack this turn - the normal play. KNOWN GAP: if played AFTER a sword attack this turn, printed text grants nothing (the first already happened) but this draft would grant to the next sword attack; no play-time condition exists to test 'no sword attack yet this turn' (ATTACK_ORDINAL_* need live combat). 'Second sword attack +1{p}' uses MODIFY_ATTACKS_THIS_TURN (effect_types.py:2149 reads amount/mod/scope/player/filter; hook conditions re-evaluated per attack at engine.py:1252). KNOWN GAP: ATTACK_ORDINAL_EQ counts ALL of that player's attacks, not only swords - exact on all-sword turns (Dorinthea's normal case), off on mixed-weapon turns. The card's own printed Go again (last line) is an unconditional DB keyword and is deliberately NOT authored here.
